blocks.content: Write a program to reverse the order of elements in a list.

items: Get four string inputs from the user and store them in the input1, input2, input3, and input4 variables.
Initialize a string list called countries.
Add input1, input2, input3, and input4 to the back of the list.
Reverse the order of the list.

blocks.content: Hint: Use the reverse() algorithm to reverse a list.

Test Inputinput1 = Nepal
input2 = Canada
input3 = Australia
input4 = India

Expected OutputNepal, Canada, Australia, India, 
India, Australia, Canada, Nepal,
